nodes.name: ade-regression.md
nodes.summary: Workflow playbook for ADE corner regression: open/create a Maestro session, drive a batch corner sweep via `vcli sim corner --file corners.json`, parse PSF results with `/maestro-read-results`, and aggregate pass/fail into a grouped bar chart via `/sim-plot`. Includes a sample tt/ss_hot/ff_cold corners.json with AC analysis and three measures (gain_dc, gbw, pm).
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown with YAML frontmatter (name/description/trigger) and a JSON code block example.

nodes.name: analog-design-flow.md
nodes.summary: End-to-end analog design closed-loop workflow: derive gm from GBW/CL and sweep L for a W/L lookup table (`/gm-over-id`), generate the schematic cellview (`/schematic-gen`), configure Ocean modelFile/desVar/resultsDir (`/sim-setup`), run DC/AC/Tran analyses (`/sim-run`), extract measures (`/sim-measure`), and visualize with matplotlib (`/sim-plot`). Documents the iterative loop when specs are not met.
nodes.languageNotes: Short markdown playbook with YAML frontmatter; lists six slash-command steps plus iteration back to sizing.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot v2 config enabling weekly PRs for the Rust Cargo manifest (root directory, ignores Cargo.lock per repo gitignore) and for GitHub Actions workflow pins (actions/* and reusable workflows). Each updater caps open PRs at 10 and tags with `dependencies` plus ecosystem-specific labels.

nodes.name: run-skill-tests.sh
nodes.summary: CI script invoked by .github/workflows/skill-tests.yml that (1) AST-parses every .claude/skills/**/*.py without writing __pycache__ (repo tracks bytecode under .claude), and (2) runs each skill's unittest discover suite, requiring at least one test actually executed and refusing to pass when no `tests/` directory exists. Exits non-zero on any syntax error, suite failure, zero-test discover, or missing suite set.
nodes.languageNotes: bash with `set -euo pipefail`; uses `python3 -m unittest discover tests`, AST parse via `python3 -c` snippet, and `grep -E "^Ran [1-9][0-9]* tests?"` for positive-test enforcement.

nodes.summary: Pensieve knowledge note covering async job lazy refresh. Captures the rule that async job status in vcli is fetched lazily on the next API call rather than polled by a monitor thread, and documents a critical caveat: a leaked / orphaned child process can re-acquire the DB lock and corrupt state. Recommends cleanup of zombies on session teardown and defines when this rule applies.
